permissions.name: alarms
permissions.description: Allows scheduling of recurring tasks or periodic executions in the background worker.

permissions.name: cookies
permissions.description: Enables querying, setting, and receiving notifications for cookie changes, often used for session management or tracking affiliate tracking cookies.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.description: Provides local and synchronized storage access for persisting user settings, coupon catalogs, and application state.

permissions.name: unlimitedStorage
permissions.description: Removes the quota limit for chrome.storage.local, vital for storing large caches of coupons, products, or merchant indexes.

permissions.name: scripting
permissions.description: Enables programmatically injecting JavaScript and CSS into target shopping web pages dynamically.

permissions.name: webRequest
permissions.description: Permits monitoring, intercepting, and modifying HTTP requests. Often used to trace checkout requests or append affiliate parameters.

permissions.name: offscreen
permissions.description: Enables creating and interacting with offscreen DOM environments, typically used to run third-party SDKs, perform audio playback, parse DOM, or manage web workers in MV3.

host_permissions.description: Grants access to run network interceptors and script injectors on any unencrypted HTTP website.
Grants access to run network interceptors and script injectors on any secure HTTPS website, which covers almost all major checkout and e-commerce portals.
